fileShareFinding.proposedScope: On Linux test managed lease release with exclusive Read/None plus a held-lock negative control on the same filesystem; retain Windows write/delete checks. No File.Open retry or deadline changes. ETXTBSY's exact post-SIGKILL MM lifetime cause is not established by this log.
fileShareFinding.semantics: FileAccess.Read maps O_RDONLY; FileShare.None maps LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB; other FileShare modes use LOCK_SH. .NET Unix locking is advisory/best-effort and may be disabled or unsupported; exclusive read evidence requires an observed negative held-lock control. ETXTBSY is distinct from flock conflict.
